review.notes: Independent package review, accepted with corrections applied in place. (1) Layer 3 relied on GeometryOfNumbersAndQuadraticArithmetic GN.2/GN.3 for the binary-form genus character and norm-witness adapters. The GN package (now TauCetiRoadmap PR #851) and IntegralLattices plan neither, so the character is restated here as Layer 3.1 `binaryFormGenusChar` (DIT §9 p.978; Gross–Kohnen–Zagier Ch. I §2 pp.508–509). It has an API (evaluation law under the fundamental-divisor hypothesis, zero law, empty factor, scaling, GL2(Z) invariance, sign law) and six discriminating Checks. (2) The Lean comparison theorem had a decorative form unlinked to the class. It is replaced by the pinned comparison with the explicit coefficient ideal a·Z+((−b+ω)/2)·Z and the oriented class (J times it when a<0); the README 3.2 proof covers all four sign cases. (3) Downstream consumers corrected: lower-tier GN removed; AN.4, Fuchsian Part II and the DIT genus averages added. Also noted that DIT's h(D) is the narrow class number, and reworded the 2.2 locator. (4) All DIT locators were read at their printed pages and match; GKZ pp.508–509 were read. (5) No duplication against current TauCetiRoadmap (0d144d04) or Tau Ceti (a91d3aaf): the ambiguous class number formulas count 2-torsion, not genus fibres, and TauCeti.BinaryQuadraticForm has no genus character. lean-check before: exit 0, 27 warnings, all sorry. After: exit 0, 16 warnings, all `declaration uses sorry` (11 theorem signatures, 5 statement-only examples), no errors or other warnings; 20 of 25 examples proved. intake check-files: 0 problems. metadata.toml unchanged (math.NT). See research/blueprint/reviews/REV-PKG-MultiquadraticPartII.md.
